M.name: Mouth (≈ MSQ Elliott River Entrance)
M.src: MSQ 2025 Tidal Planes secondary place: HW -9 min, LW -9 min on Bundaberg (Burnett Heads); planes MHWS 3.02 MHWN 2.40 MLWN 1.19 MLWS 0.57 m LAT — place is 5.4 km from this mouth

M.name: Tidal limit (est.)
M.src: Generic extrapolation 1.5 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of all calibrated QLD places/gauges in this region (HW +2.0, LW +3.2 min/km); at a natural tidal limit highs ≈ 0.15 m lower than downstream and lows drain out (water-starts-rising, like upper Baffle)

confidence.why: short creek with an official reference at the mouth; upper reach extrapolated
